queries_run: Cloudflare go-to-market change 2026 channel partners self-serve pay-as-you-go shift
Cloudflare business model transition pay per crawl AI agents platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 描述銷售為 Enterprise 方案直銷加通路夥伴（MSP、經銷、分銷、GSI），並以免費方案→隨用隨付→Enterprise 的漏斗獲客；未顯示通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: We sell our products under our Enterprise plans directly to customers through our global, technically-oriented inside and field sales teams, and indirectly through our ecosystem of channel partners that includes managed service providers, resellers, distributors, and global system integrators.

findings.claim: Cloudflare 於 2026-07-01 宣布 Pay Per Crawl 演進為 Pay Per Use（按使用付費的內容/代理存取市集）；為次級來源報導，細節待官方確認。
findings.source: pasqualepillitteri.it：Cloudflare Blocks AI Crawlers by Default: From Pay Per Crawl to Pay Per Use
findings.excerpt: On 1 July 2026, Cloudflare said its crawler marketplace, Pay Per Crawl, is evolving into Pay Per Use.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋僅 2 次；未見通路去中介化或 D2C 轉移證據。
